items.what: Words typed into the site's own search box when the search finds nothing, with how many times each was searched and the first and last day it was seen. Nothing that points to a person is kept: no IP address, browser or time of the search. Words that look like an email address, a phone number or a web address are not kept.
items.where: This website's database, as one list
items.kept: 90 days after the words were last searched, or until someone clears the list. At most 200 searches are kept.
items.when: only while the list of searches that found nothing is on in Search settings, which it is by default, and not for people logged in to edit the site

items.what: A scrambled (hashed) copy of the search words and the visitor's IP address, so one visitor's repeat searches count once
items.where: A temporary record in this website's database
items.when: only while the search words are kept

notes: Scout Core sets no cookies. Its email guard only changes how email addresses are written into the page, and it stores nothing. The dashboard remembers which sections a staff member opened, in their own browser (scoutSections), which never touches visitors.
